reflect.title: Reflect with your story
reflect.intro: A space to find patterns, remember lessons and ask yourself better questions.
reflect.consent: When you send a message, the AI receives the text of all your experiences to respond with context. Your photos and PDFs are never shared. The conversation stays in your space; the request is sent without OpenAI response storage.
reflect.consentAction: I understand and want to continue
reflect.placeholder: What would you like to understand better?
reflect.empty: Try: “What patterns do you notice in my recent changes?”
reflect.disclaimer: This is not a substitute for medical, psychological or emergency support.
reflect.sendError: Your message could not be sent.
reflect.incomplete: I could not complete this reflection. Please try again in a moment.
reflect.emptyList: No conversations yet. Start one when you are ready.
reflect.deleteBody: The messages in this chat will be removed from your space. This cannot be undone.
reflect.actionError: That change could not be saved.
reflect.notFound: That conversation is no longer available.
reflect.validation: Check the title and try again.
